clips.title: The story
paras: Foul Matriarch is a trial of survival assigned by Aetheen of the Gales to budding initiates in Thendal Village. The task demands delving into the southern caves to cull the scavenging ursera and slay their vicious den mother, Urs'anah. Completing the hunt proves that an adventurer possesses the resolve required to face greater perils across Zephras Isle.

Aetheen of the Gales maintains a watchful eye on newcomers finding their footing around Thendal Village. Once an initiate demonstrates early competence, Aetheen issues a dangerous rite of passage: a direct assault against the predatory wildlife threatening the perimeter. Rather than simply fighting on the open paths, the initiate is sent directly into the dark caves to the south to thin the local ursera packs and confront their broodmother.

The local rangers have long noted the ferocity of the ursera, but none poses a greater threat to the haven than Urs'anah, their formidable matriarch. Sheltered deep within Thendal Cave, she directs her scavengers and aggressively defends her lair. Bringing back her severed head serves as definitive proof that an adventurer is capable of handling ferocious beasts and is ready to push beyond the borders of the starting grove.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.
